subject: Video idea: a website the next person can take over
text:
Hi Matty,

Your profile links to your Powerful Websites videos, so I thought this might fit a short website-discovery segment.

I built Take The Wall: one public page with one featured owner. The next takeover replaces the previous project or message for everyone. The video hook is: “What would you put on a website that somebody else can take over?”

https://takethewall.com/?utm_source=mattymctech&utm_medium=creator&utm_campaign=shared_page&utm_content=video_idea

I attached a 15-second recording of the actual mobile/desktop preview using example content. No purchase or activation is shown. You can use the clip in a post about the project, or record the public preview yourself without paying.

Watching and previewing are free; publishing a takeover costs $3.99, with no guaranteed duration or audience. This is a content suggestion, with no paid partnership request.
